body:
Fights in the repeated hag encounters and taunts those trying to stop her.

Recorded role and choices

Gertrude appears in the September and November 2025 confrontations, reacts to Nymera’s attacks and exchanges threats with the company. A later demand concerning a child forms part of her threatening speech. Her repeated, named participation distinguishes her from an unspecified hag label. These selected actor messages do not establish a final death or permanent escape.
